rows.text: [Trailblazer], the Simulated Universe has been updated. We've added a new algorithm branch to the expansion module.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: For me, #27 Rubert is one of the most intriguing members in the Society. It proclaimed itself to be an emperor and started a crisis in the Machine Empire known throughout the universe — The First Emperor's War.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Ruan Mei plans to cultivate Nous, and Screwllum has always been interested in the origins of inorganic lives. So, we quickly found ourselves on the same page and decided to focus on the time before the death of #27 Rubert.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: The first step is to extract concepts such as calculation and logic systematically. Then, we need to organize them and filter out content related to inorganic lives.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Prepare yourself, for you're about to witness the history of the cosmic Droidhead.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: You'll know it when you go through it. There's no point in listening to my description without seeing the real thing, right?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: The IPC seems interested in the Simulated Universe project...
Of course, they would be. Who wouldn't? I'm already discussing with them about the implementation of the project.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Be a good tester and do your best.
rows.speaker: Herta
